hanzi-writer-data 2.0.1
https://github.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data
Stroke outlines and medians derived from Make Me a Hanzi (skishore),
itself extracted from Arphic fonts. Redistributed under the Arphic
Public License; ARPHICPL.TXT is packed unaltered.

On 2026-08-30 the per-character JSON was concatenated into vendor/chars.js
for offline packing. Glyphs were not redrawn, reordered, or renamed.

HSK 2.0 unique characters (levels 1–3, 618 hanzi) plus 永. Pinyin is
taken from the public exam word readings. Short English glosses were
written for this port and are not copied from CC-CEDICT.
